# Data sources

Every table in the warehouse carries a `source` column so real and synthetic rows are never confused. This file lists where each real source came from, when it was downloaded, and exactly what is synthetic or illustrative.

**Hard rule honored throughout:** no real student-, classroom-, or teacher-level data exists anywhere in this repository. All of it is generated by `warehouse/seed/` from a seed string.

## Real public aggregate data

| Source | What we use | Downloaded | Files | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|

District values in the app are **enrollment-weighted roll-ups** of buildings (`district_measures`, source `pde-derived`), the same method used in CSIU's own regional attendance workbook. Values reported as IS (insufficient sample) are omitted. |

## Synthetic data (seeded generator)

Generated by `npm run seed` (`warehouse/seed/synth.ts`, seed `csiu-2026`). Reproducible; change `SEED` to get a different universe.

- **Students (28,930)**, scaled to each building's real 2024-25 enrollment, with demographics drawn from each building's real percentages. Names come from name lists; state IDs are synthetic 10-digit numbers.
- **Staff, classrooms, homerooms** — one teacher per homeroom, principal/counselor/nurse per building.
- **Daily attendance** for 2026-27 to date (39 school days) and prior-year totals. Calibrated so each building's synthetic chronic-absence rate tracks its **real** regular-attendance rate; grade-6/9 transition effects, Monday patterns, and "rising absences" trajectories are built in.
- **Course grades** (prior-year final, MP1, current), **benchmark screeners** (three windows 2025-26 + fall 2026-27; tool names per district), **weekly progress monitoring** for students in academic supports.
- **Behavior referrals** (category, location, time of day — including after-lunch concentrations), **nurse visits**, **Project AWARE wellness screens** (fall/spring 2025-26, fall 2026-27), **weekly check-ins**.
- **Interventions and outcomes** — 18,460 support episodes with start date, days from flag to start, dosage, fidelity, funding, provider, and pre/post outcome measures; plus a `student_outcomes` row for every student in every domain so treated students can be compared with similar untreated students. Program effect sizes are *assumed* (e.g., CICO 61% vs. 36% untreated; early start +12 points) so the "what works" story is demonstrable; they are not estimates from real data.
- **Risk index** (`student_risk`) — additive, explainable points from attendance, behavior, course grades, screeners, wellness; thresholds 60/40/22 for high/moderate/watch.
- **Building monthly attendance** for prior years (anchored to each building's real year-end rate), **instruction minutes**, **staffing**.
- **SIS exports** in `sis/exports/sample/` — Sapphire-style CSVs generated from the synthetic warehouse for Shikellamy; the loader (`npm run sis:load`) round-trips them.

## Illustrative (curated, not verified)

- **Curriculum and program adoptions** (`program_adoptions`, source `illustrative`): which ELA/math core, phonics supplement, SEL curriculum, PBIS/CICO/restorative practices, Project AWARE counseling, and Botvin each district uses, with adoption years. Chosen to be plausible for PA districts so "how long have they used it" has an answer; the only real signal is that SAP is required in all PA districts.
- **Screeners in use** (`screeners_in_use`): Bloomsburg (Acadience), Millville and Southern Columbia (aimswebPlus) reflect documents in the CSIU Drive; the rest are illustrative.
- **Project AWARE partner districts**: illustrative. Replace with the real partner list.

## Not used (available in Drive, out of scope for the prototype)

Acadience training decks and manuals, aimswebPlus getting-started guide, SAP training decks, wellness-check policy drafts, the "Annual CSIU Program Statistics 2024-25" PDF (CSIU service counts could feed the insight-card service links later).
